why_ai: Field sampling on real sites plus signatures by environmental professionals and geologists keep humans required.
why_clarity: ASTM and state protocols codify recurring assessments, though liability outcomes surface slowly.
why_digital: Work starts from physical sites and samples, ends as reports, sold to regional clients.

why_ai: Bespoke liability allocation and incentive stacking run on relationships with agencies and developers.
why_clarity: Each redevelopment combines unique contamination, finance and regulatory terms with no standard playbook.
why_digital: Advisory work is documentary, but deals are local and relationship-driven around physical sites.

why_ai: Physical samples must be analysed on accredited instruments within holding times; AI cannot run chemistry.
why_clarity: Accredited methods with QC limits give objective pass or fail on millions of samples.
why_digital: Physical soil and water samples analysed at benches, results delivered as electronic data packages.

why_ai: Normalising lab deliverables and comparing against screening levels is the automation the product already is.
why_clarity: Each result is compared deterministically against a published screening level.
why_digital: Electronic lab data in, normalised datasets and compliance reports out in software.

why_ai: Carriers put capital behind long-tail contaminated-site risk, with underwriters accountable for pricing.
why_clarity: Remediation cost overruns reveal whether a price was right only years after binding.
why_digital: Site reports underwritten on screens, policies placed through national broker channels.

why_ai: Community engagement depends on in-person trust, though demand rides on volatile federal funding.
why_clarity: Success blends data screening with community outcomes that are contested and slow to appear.
why_digital: Public datasets combine with in-person community meetings for local organisations.

why_ai: A century of assembled, geocoded records is costly to rebuild, though retrieval automates easily.
why_clarity: Radius reports follow a fixed search specification per site, thousands of times a year.
why_digital: Digitised records searched and delivered as online reports bought per site.

why_ai: ASTM's federally recognised consensus standard derives its force from the body, not the text.
why_clarity: Balloting is codified, but revisions are rare consensus judgments with no quick test.
why_digital: Committee drafting and ballots happen online and in meetings; the standard is sold digitally.

why_ai: Federal toxicity values carry regulatory force and rest on contested scientific judgment.
why_clarity: Systematic review protocols are written down, but each assessment takes years and lacks ground truth.
why_digital: Literature reviewed and values published online, with no commercial buyer outside government.

why_ai: Generic tablet form apps are commodity software that AI-native tools replicate easily.
why_clarity: Forms and chain-of-custody records are defined artefacts checked at sample receipt.
why_digital: Software built and sold remotely to consulting firms.

why_ai: Validation follows deterministic EPA method rules that software can apply with a validator's signature.
why_clarity: Holding times, duplicates and qualifiers are checked against written rules on every dataset.
why_digital: Lab reports in, qualified data and validation reports out, all on screens.

why_ai: Stamped regulatory submissions and field investigations at thousands of sites need accountable professionals.
why_clarity: Statutory report formats recur at scale, though agency review takes months.
why_digital: Field data feeds report production delivered to regulators for national clients.

why_ai: The firm assumes cleanup obligations with its own capital and must execute physical remediation.
why_clarity: Each property's liability is priced uniquely and actual costs emerge over years.
why_digital: Contaminated properties are bought, physically remediated and redeveloped through local deals.

why_ai: Field species and wetland surveys plus litigated documents protect the work, though AI drafts much text.
why_clarity: Agency formats are defined, but acceptance depends on reviewers and opponents' litigation.
why_digital: Field surveys feed documents reviewed by agencies, bought by regional project owners.

why_ai: Permit conditions state exact intervals and actions, a calendar task software handles entirely.
why_clarity: Every obligation has a written deadline that is met or missed.
why_digital: Permit documents in, compliance calendars and alerts out, all on screens.

why_ai: An environmental professional must visit and sign, but most report content is automatable boilerplate.
why_clarity: ASTM E1527-21 prescribes the checklist, repeated hundreds of times a year per firm.
why_digital: Database research and report writing dominate, plus a brief site visit near the property.

why_ai: Quarterly field monitoring and stamped submittals over decade-long client relationships keep humans in charge.
why_clarity: Monitoring protocols repeat quarterly, but remedy success takes years to confirm.
why_digital: Groundwater sampling on site feeds reports for regional clients.

why_ai: The vendor sells physical reagents and thermal equipment that AI cannot substitute.
why_clarity: Treatment performance varies with site geochemistry and is judged over months of monitoring.
why_digital: Physical treatment products designed on screens but applied in the ground at sites.

why_ai: State statute vests closure authority in agency staff who are publicly accountable for determinations.
why_clarity: Cleanup standards exist, but each site's closure involves contested technical judgment.
why_digital: Submitted reports reviewed on screens; regulated parties must deal with their own state.

why_ai: Named experts testify personally on causation, contested by opposing experts and courts.
why_clarity: Assessments are contested by regulators and opposing experts, with no objective answer.
why_digital: Documents and data analysed on screens, but testimony is given in person to national clients.

why_ai: Remote fieldwork for sovereign tribal nations depends on physical access and earned trust.
why_clarity: Monitoring protocols are standard, but remote conditions make each programme different.
why_digital: Remote sites, limited connectivity and paper files; providers must show up in person.

why_digital: Physical tanks tested on site, records on paper, served by local specialists.
